items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And of course, Buster Bailey is gone, he's passed away.

ctx.x: Empathy of feeling together, just like we're talking. You must do the same thing with a band and musically because you must feel together and think together. Same as a conversation. And this is an important thing. Now I usually have a six piece band. I usually like to try to get three black and three white. This represents America to me. And it represents music also. Well you can't always do that because some guy's working or it's not enough money or whatever it is, but I usually come pretty close. Maybe it's…

And I always say, what the hell am I doing here? I say it when I kid around. We have a ball. But I noticed two trombone players that I would love to have right off the bat and that Tyree Glenn or Vic Dickenson. Those two guys are so individual. They are beautiful guys. Oh, they're lovely. And then there's Herb Hall on clarinet, Edmond Hall's brother. And of course, Buster Bailey is gone, he's passed away.
Who would you have on bass?
